text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Cytomegalovirus (CMV) Retinitis. The combination of AIDS with a low CD4 count, unilateral vision loss, floaters ("black spots"), and a sectoral visual field defect is classic for CMV retinitis. I recommend immediate initiation of ganciclovir therapy and ophthalmologic follow-up.
